cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko, time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
time.sleep(8)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("Port 3000:", stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 status | grep areloria")
print("Status:", stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 8 --nostream 2>&1 | tail -8")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
